Privacy Terms Accessibility Back to Products OD300 2-Mode Overdrive/Distortion Effects Pedal 1 / 3 Zoom View in fullscreen OD300 2-Mode Overdrive/Distortion Effects Pedal Share Overview Learning Features About this product 2-Mode Overdrive/Distortion Effects Pedal OVERDRIVE/DISTORTION OD300 Some songs call for an edgy modern-crunch; others call for the classic sound of hot and bothered tubes – still others need a little of both. The OVERDRIVE/DISTORTION OD300 has all your bases covered, allowing you to expertly sculpt your tone with the Level, Tone, Drive and Mode controls. Truckloads of Tone Thanks to the OD300’s Overdrive/Distortion blend dial, you can turn all the way to the left for pure overdrive, or all the way to the right for straight-ahead distortion. In between, you get an infinite amount of options for creating the perfect overdrive/distortion cocktail. And with the dedicated Tone, Level and Drive dials, everything you need to create a signature sound is right at your fingertips. Ease of Use The LED tells you when the OD300 is working its magic, and the top-quality on/off switch maintains excellent signal integrity in bypass mode. You can power the OD300 with either a 9 V battery or our PSU-SB DC power supply (not included). Sound Value Why settle for just overdrive or distortion when you can have both? Set your tone on fi re with distortion, overdrive, or a potent blend of both – with the OVERDRIVE/DISTORTION OD300. Check one out at your local dealer today, or get yours online!
